ITEM 1 | Square white plate, roughly 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; the photo is rotated so the plate appears sideways. | 0
ITEM 2 | Pale green-beige coating with a rough, grainy, crumbly texture and small flecks of green, covering two or three fillet-like pieces stacked over a pinkish-orange flesh layer, total footprint about 40 percent of the plate, roughly 2 to 2.5 cm thick, moist-looking with a slight sheen. | 230
ITEM 3 | Pinkish-orange flesh showing beneath the green-beige crust on the right side, flaky and moist, partly exposed, sitting under the coated topping, about 1.5 cm thick. | 110
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with slightly golden edges, lightly cooked, several pieces about 2 to 3 cm across, clustered at the lower center of the plate. | 75
ITEM 5 | Broccoli florets, bright to dark green with firm stalks, about 2 to 4 cm across, scattered along the bottom edge beside the cauliflower, slightly glossy. | 80
ITEM 6 | Sliced brown-tan mushrooms or similar fungi, soft and glossy with a light sheen, cut into thick slices about 0.5 to 1 cm, lying in a cluster on the left side of the plate. | 60
ITEM 7 | Dark green wilted leafy greens, limp and glossy, a few leaves about 4 to 6 cm long, tucked among the mushrooms on the left. | 25
ITEM 8 | Light brown cooked meat pieces in small irregular chunks with browned edges and fibrous texture, about 2 to 3 cm, sitting among the mushrooms and greens on the left. | 70
ITEM 9 | Glossy brown sauce or gravy coating the meat and mushrooms, thin and slightly translucent, pooling in small amounts around the left-side items. | 15
